title: (RHBA-2019:1725) Red Hat Ceph Storage 2.5 bug fix update
portal_summary: An update is now available for Red Hat Ceph Storage 2.5.

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Ceph Storage is a scalable, open, software-defined storage platform
that combines the most stable version of the Ceph storage system with a
Ceph management platform, deployment utilities, and support services.

Bug Fix(es):

* Due to an invalid access after the execution of copy constructor, the Ceph Object Gateway could terminate unexpectedly with a segmentation fault. This update fixes the initialization logic, and the Ceph Object Gateway no longer crashes in this case. (BZ#1711392)
